proposals.evidence: Probable Pashto loan. The compiled Hallberg survey supplies exact mexā buffalo in Swat, Charsadda and other locations, alongside mexa in Peshawar/Dir and meśā in Jalalabad. This dialect distribution makes the x-bearing Pashto comparator particularly relevant to Dameli mexā. OPED independently attests the Pashto buffalo family in gāwmeṣ̌a buffalo-cow and مېښو in the herd-of-buffalo example. Turner9964 documents the wider mahiṣa family, including a Katir buffalo compound in its addendum, but no direct Dameli reflex; that does not justify skipping the possible Pashto donor. Original survey-page verification and borrowing direction remain pending.
